how_to_apply: Candidates can follow these steps to submit the SCL Recruitment 2026 application form.
Visit the official SCL recruitment page at scl.gov.in/career.html.
Open the online application link for Advertisement No. SCL:DR:01/2026.
New applicants should select New Registration.
Complete the registration process using the required personal and contact details.
Save the registration number and login credentials.
Log in through the Registered User Login page.
Select the eligible post and relevant trade or discipline.
Fill in the required personal, educational and experience details.
Upload the documents requested by the application portal.

Verify the application details and complete final submission.

content_sections.text: The SCL online registration process started on 1 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. Candidates must complete their applications and examination fee payment before the closing date.

content_sections.heading: Semi-Conductor Laboratory Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The Semiconductor Laboratory Vacancy 2026 includes a total of 83 regular posts across administrative and technical categories. The vacancies are distributed as follows. Under SCL Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 , 30 vacancies are available across 11 technical disciplines. Candidates must possess the prescribed First Class Diploma, B.Sc. or other accepted qualification with two years of relevant post-qualification experience . The SCL Technician 'B' Recruitment 2026 includes 41 vacancies for ITI-qualified candidates in various technical trades. Applicants need Matriculation / SSLC with the prescribed ITI or accepted trade certificate and two years of relevant post-qualification experience. The administrative category includes 12 vacancies for Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer, Purchase & Stores Officer and Junior Personal Assistant posts.

tables.caption: two years of relevant post-qualification experience

content_sections.heading: SCL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility and Qualification
content_sections.text: The educational qualification and experience requirements for SCL Recruitment 2026 depend on the selected post. Candidates should verify the specific eligibility conditions before applying. Important: The administrative officer posts require relevant supervisory experience. For Technical Assistant and Technician 'B', the prescribed experience must be obtained after completing the qualifying education. Candidates should read the post-specific conditions in the detailed notification. For most Technical Assistant disciplines, candidates must possess a First Class three-year full-time Diploma in the respective engineering field with two years of post-qualification experience. For Electronics, SCL also accepts a First Class B.Sc. in Electronics. For Computer Science, the notification provides an alternative through First Class BCA / Computer Science qualifications. For Physics and Chemistry, candidates need the prescribed First Class B.Sc. qualification in the relevant subject. Technician 'B' applicants must have passed Matriculation / SSLC and completed the prescribed two-year ITI course from an NCVT-recognized institution in the respective trade, or hold an accepted National Apprenticeship Certificate / National Trade Certificate. Two years of relevant post-qualification experience is also required. Candidates applying for Junior Personal Assistant must have passed Class 12 from a recognized board. The stenography requirement includes 10 minutes of dictation at 80 words per minute and transcription on a computer within 50 minutes for English or 65 minutes for Hindi.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Semi-Conductor Laboratory has announced 83 vacancies for Technician 'B', Technical Assistant, Junior Personal Assistant and administrative officer posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online and pay the examination fee is 30 November 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply online for SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can register through the official SCL application portal. New applicants must complete registration, while existing applicants can use the Registered User Login link.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for SCL Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applicants generally require a First Class three-year Diploma in the relevant discipline or an accepted B.Sc. / BCA qualification, along with two years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. How many Technical Assistant vacancies are available in SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 30 Technical Assistant vacancies across 11 technical disciplines.

faq.question: Q6. How many Technician B vacancies are available in SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 41 Technician 'B' vacancies across 12 technical trades.

faq.question: Q7. Can ITI candidates apply for SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. ITI-qualified candidates can apply for eligible Technician 'B' trades if they meet the qualification, two-year post-qualification experience and age requirements.

faq.question: Q8. What is the SCL Technical Assistant salary per month?
faq.answer: The starting basic pay is Rs. 44,900 per month, with approximate monthly emoluments of Rs. 83,700 as mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the SCL Technician B salary in 2026?
faq.answer: The starting basic pay for Technician 'B' is Rs. 21,700 per month, with approximate monthly emoluments of Rs. 41,940.

faq.question: Q10. What is the age limit for SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years for officer posts, 25 years for Junior Personal Assistant, 30 years for Technical Assistant and 27 years for Technician 'B', with applicable relaxations.
